solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Court's ending morally unprincipled row

parts.note: base means low and dishonourable in morals
a row of things is a line of them

explanation.surface: Someone lamenting a court case that ended in an immoral squabble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Court' suggests law, but it is a tennis court here.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis the line marking the far end of the playing area is called by this name.

clue.text: Small creature — see me capture it

indicators.note: me is said to capture it, so the word it sits held within me

explanation.surface: A tiny bug telling you to watch it being caught.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny arachnid, often used of any very small creature or child.

clue.text: Countryside stroll won't begin as a leisurely walk

indicators.note: the stroll word loses its opening letter, as it will not start

parts.note: a ramble is a walk in the country

explanation.surface: A country walk that never gets going stays merely a gentle saunter.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to saunter or walk at an easy, unhurried pace is this word, used here as a noun.

clue.text: Exposes druggy episode where pilots pick up speed

parts.note: to air something is to expose it, so airs means exposes
a trip is a hallucinatory experience on drugs

explanation.surface: A news story revealing a drug-fuelled episode at the place planes take off.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip of ground used as a runway, where aircraft accelerate for take-off.

clue.text: Plain wicked imprisoning fifty

indicators.note: the word for wicked holds the numeral inside it like a prisoner

parts.note: bad means wicked
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A plain-spoken villain locking up fifty people.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a bald statement is plain and blunt, without any softening.

clue.text: Discharge head of Egyptian embassy

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a diplomatic mission is an embassy

explanation.surface: An order to dismiss the Egyptian ambassador.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Discharge' reads as a verb about sacking, but it is the noun meaning something given off.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a discharge of gas or fluid is an emission, something sent out.

clue.text: Prima donna keen to do a turn

indicators.note: the keen word turns round and reads backwards

parts.note: avid means keen

explanation.surface: A leading lady eager to perform her act on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a celebrated female opera singer, the leading soprano of a company.

clue.text: Pacific island backed it to secure a great success

indicators.note: the backwards it holds the other pieces safely inside
it is written backwards, going back to front

parts.note: a hit is a great success

explanation.surface: A gambler backing an island bet, hoping it secures a big win.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' turns IT into TI, which then holds A and HIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the largest island of French Polynesia, in the South Pacific.

clue.text: Servant that's some help after start of marriage

indicators.note: the help word comes after the initial letter
the start of a word is its first letter

parts.note: aid means help

explanation.surface: A domestic helper who assists once a marriage begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a female domestic servant, such as a housemaid.

clue.text: Withdrew, blushing about some poetry

indicators.note: the colour word goes about, around, the poetry word

parts.note: a blushing face is red
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: A shy poet pulling out of a reading, embarrassed by their lines.
explanation.definitionFit: To reverse a decision or judgement is to withdraw or revoke it.

clue.text: Hitch small and inferior horse

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a nag is a poor old horse

explanation.surface: Harnessing a small, poor-quality horse to a cart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hitch' suggests hitching a horse, but it means a problem.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a hitch or snag is an unexpected obstacle or difficulty.

clue.text: Drunk, brimful with a Chile wine

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters are reeling into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone tipsy after a glass filled to the brim with Chilean wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a sweet white German wine from the Rhine region.

clue.text: Voted to share out in foundation

indicators.note: the share word goes in the foundation word

parts.note: a bed is a foundation, as in a bed of concrete
to allot is to share out

explanation.surface: A committee voting on how to divide up the funds of a charitable foundation.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to ballot is to vote by secret paper, so balloted means voted.

clue.text: End up with one unfortunately still done up

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests letters that have come to grief and are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone ending up with a present that, sadly, is still wrapped.
explanation.definitionFit: A parcel still done up, with its wrapping intact, has not been opened.

clue.text: First of chaps having inclination for domestic work?

indicators.note: the first of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: a leaning is an inclination or tendency

explanation.surface: A man who has a liking for household chores.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: dusting and scrubbing are household tasks, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Bore given job with everything that may be desired

definitions.text: with everything that may be desired

parts.note: a bore is a hole drilled for water, a well
appointed means given a post

explanation.surface: A tedious person getting a job that seems perfect in every respect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bore' looks like a dull person, but it is a drilled shaft.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-appointed room or house is fully equipped and furnished.

clue.text: Too wrapped up in choral societies

indicators.note: the letters are wrapped inside the words, spanning both

explanation.surface: Someone also deeply absorbed in their choir groups.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: both mean in addition or as well.

clue.text: Young man carrying round burden

indicators.note: the young man holds the round letter inside him

parts.note: a lad is a young man
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A boy carrying a heavy weight round about.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a load is a heavy burden borne by someone.

clue.text: Walking on rocky gradient

indicators.note: rocky means unsteady, so the letters are shaken up

explanation.surface: A hiker making their way up a stony slope.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to tread on something is to walk on it.

clue.text: Container connected to end of large pipe

parts.note: a tub is a container

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A vessel attached to the end of a big pipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Container' looks like the definition, but it is TUB; 'pipe' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a tube is a hollow cylinder, a pipe.

clue.text: Time in the year for fruit

definitions.meaning: a day of the calendar, such as 5 May
the sweet brown fruit of a palm tree

explanation.surface: The season when a certain fruit is ripe.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a calendar day and the fruit of the palm.

clue.text: Final defeat on board for partner

definitions.meaning: in chess, checkmate ends the game on the board

explanation.surface: A board game loss suffered by your partner.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: chess checkmate, and a companion or spouse.

clue.text: Size of former accommodation on camp

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
a tent is shelter on a campsite

explanation.surface: Asking how big an old campsite shelter was.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the extent of something is its size or scope.

clue.text: Great fear of adder wriggling around

indicators.note: the snake's letters wriggle into a new order

explanation.surface: Terror of a snake writhing about.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: dread is intense fear or apprehension.
